title: Target selection, retention and reticle resource analysis

claims.Finding: Returns the global float target-search scale at RVA2A1141C.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Returns the global float manual lock-on retention distance at RVA2A11420.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: XMM0 float setter stores the target-search scale, multiplies it by loaded system parameter float+80, and stores the product as retention distance. The decompiler omits the float argument; full SSE instructions establish the ABI and float32 order.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: XMM0 float setter updates only the retention-distance global; it does not rescale acquisition.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Scene targeting initialization sets scale1 and retention distance from loaded system parameters+80; these runtime globals are reinitialized by scene loading.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Publishes the nested pref BAR and first type2 plyr/fmab/prty/magi/sstm payloads. The signed DWORD at sstm payload+4 is added to that payload to install system parameters, or produces null when zero.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Loads the system BAR, publishes it at RVA2AE5E50 and passes its first type2 pref payload to3E9360. Targeting parameter ownership therefore follows outer allocation -> pref entry -> nested sstm entry, not a separate nested heap allocation.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Developer setup passes float4 to the scale setter, then separately overrides retention to 4*system parameter+76 +500. This differs from the ordinary setter's scaled parameter+80.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Script trap reads a float argument and tail-calls the target-search-scale setter with XMM0.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Manual acquisition iterates eligible actors and type3 target points. Uses global scale*system parameter+76, skips point bit1, applies distance minus target-point radius and ranks candidates by proximity. Actor flag+1736 bit0x400 bypasses the distance limit when scale>=1.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Automatic selector uses player parameter+92 for radius, +96/+100 for vertical bounds, and +108/+112 for vertical/facing score. A nonpositive radius skips range/height tests; scale above1 expands vertical bounds. This is why the trainer does not expose a zero multiplier.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Manual target cycling excludes the current actor/point and orders candidates by signed angular direction. XMM3 supplies the direction omitted by some decompiler signatures. It retains manual radius and special-target exemptions.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Alternate target switch uses a supplied direction vector, a dot threshold0.5 and distance eligibility; it is not interchangeable with the ordinary signed-angle switch.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Resolves a20-byte target reference to its chosen type3 point, then a first-point fallback; when no point exists uses actor position. A distinct encoded alternative field at+8 has its own branch.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Normal targeting update validates scene/input/actor conditions and current target. Manual retention compares distance to the separate global unless the native flag0x400/scale exemption applies, then executes input transitions and reticle updates.

claims.Finding: Lock context modes0/1/2 implement none/automatic/manual transitions. Input bit0x800 requests lock; high input bits cycle manually. Automatic hold timer at+32 decreases by native frame delta while the target remains eligible.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

claims.Finding: Lock-mode transition clears previous resources, writes state and validated target reference, plays sound7 for manual mode, updates the camera, target logging, Scan gauge and reticle. It has far broader lifetime requirements than scalar range edits.
claims.Limitations: Static behavior in the exact Steam1.0.0.2 executable. Resource contents, target exceptions and live engine interactions are not validated by synthetic tests.

implementation: Six targeting entries368..373. Two bounded one-time float edits, a loaded-default reset and three readouts. Stable Sora/context/resource ownership validation. No lock-mode, target, camera or reticle allocation calls.
validation: 614 focused synthetic checks, zero failures. Fresh auto_wait readiness, unchanged36451-function inventory and full postwait loader/setter assembly. Live gameplay pending.
